description: Search the 6,994 lease comps from the U.S. General Services Administration's Lease Inventory (October 2026 file, FactLot release lease-comps-gsa-2026-11-04), bundled with FactLot: works offline and on the hosted API, no registry needed. READ THE CAVEAT: the tenant in every one of these leases is the federal government (GSA, for an agency); they are not market comps for private tenants, and the rent is the current annual rent in GSA's file divided by the rentable SF, not the starting rent (no escalations, free rent, TI or commissions are known). Filter by state, 5-digit county FIPS, city, ZIP, a radius around a latitude/longitude (GSA's own coordinates; nothing is geocoded), rentable SF, commencement date, rent per SF, property type (office, industrial, other) and expense basis; sort; limit (default 25, at most 200). Each comp gives its FactLot lease ID, GSA lease number, address, county FIPS, building ID, landlord (organisations only; individuals are never stored), rentable SF, commencement, expiration, term, early-termination date, annual rent, rent per SF per year, property type, expense basis and the row of the GSA file it comes from. summary gives the count and the median, quartiles and range of rent per SF over every match, labelled as statistics of GSA leases. Every answer carries the caveat and the citation (GSA file URL, SHA-256 document ID, as-of and retrieval dates, licence: public domain). These are statistics of GSA leases, kept apart from market comps.

city.description: City as GSA writes it, matched whole and ignoring case, e.g. "Houston".

county_fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS code (state + county), e.g. "48201" for Harris County, Texas. Connecticut uses its planning regions (09110 to 09190).

limit.description: Maximum comps returned (1–200, default 25); the summary covers every match.

max_rent_psf_yr.description: Highest current rent, USD per rentable SF per year.

min_rent_psf_yr.description: Lowest current rent, USD per rentable SF per year (GSA's current annual rent divided by the RSF).

near.description: Comps within a radius of a point, by great-circle distance to the coordinates GSA's file gives for each lease (FactLot geocodes nothing; give the point's coordinates yourself). Comps without coordinates are left out and counted in warnings.

radius_miles.description: Radius in miles (at most 500). Must be greater than 0.

property_type.description: office, industrial (GSA warehouse) or other (GSA special space): the largest use in the lease.

sort.description: Order of results: distance_asc (the default with near; needs near), commencement_desc (the default otherwise), commencement_asc, expiration_asc, expiration_desc, rent_psf_desc, rent_psf_asc, rentable_sf_desc, rentable_sf_asc. Ties go by GSA lease number.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, e.g. "TX".

name: lease_comp_search
title: Search GSA lease comps (federal tenant)
